title: Purair® FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets
meta_title: Purair FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets - Vertical Airflow Hoods
meta_description: Purair FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow hoods use HEPA filtration to protect equipment and contents from particulates. Ideal for limited lab spaces.
meta_keywords: laminar flow cabinets, vertical laminar flow hoods, HEPA filtration, clean benches, laboratory equipment
short_description: Purair® FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow hoods are compact and ideal for laboratory environments with limited space. The vertical laminar flow hoods use HEPA filtration to protect equipment and other contents of the work zone from particulates.
full_description: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration protects materials inside the cabinet from particulates. High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal fan. Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 5. Energy saving LED lighting. Large front opening provides unrestricted access to the work zone.
seo_content: Purair FLOW Series vertical laminar flow cabinets are designed for non-hazardous applications where user protection from biologicals or biohazardous byproducts is not required. These compact benchtop units are ideal for a variety of laboratory environments including mycology, cell culture, cleanrooms, pharmaceutical production, and more.
features_data: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration
